title: Intelligent Transport Systems (ITS); Radiocommunications equipment operating in the 5 855 MHz to 5 925 MHz frequency band; Harmonized EN covering the essential requirements of article 3.2 of the R&TTE Directive
note: Extracted with pdftotext -layout; clause numbers verbatim. This file replaces the WAF-block-page 'en302571_v211.pdf' previously (mistakenly) archived in the W1-C search corpus.

table_2b_nominal_carriers.note: 10 MHz channels; attacker model uses the [0,+10] MHz rel. 5895 MHz allocation (G5-SCH2-equivalent geometry)

table_7_unwanted_inside_its_bands_10mhz.definition: clause 6.4.2: unwanted emissions (e.i.r.p.) INSIDE the 5 GHz ITS bands, at highest power level; mean levels of the transmitted spectrum
table_7_unwanted_inside_its_bands_10mhz.reductions: limits reduced by 10 dB for G5-SCH2/G5-SCH3 and by 33 dB for G5-SCH4
table_7_unwanted_inside_its_bands_10mhz.interpolation_note: paper implementation interpolates linearly in dB between the tabulated offsets; beyond +-15 MHz within the ITS band the -27 dBm/MHz value is held (conservative)

table_6a_unwanted_outside_its_bands.definition: clause 6.4.1.2, spurious >= 2.5x channel BW from centre; e.i.r.p. limits, 1 MHz RBW (table 6b gives 1 kHz RBW closer in)

fcc_47cfr_95_3205.cite: 47 CFR 95.3205, Unwanted emissions limits (C-V2X OBUs); 89 FR 100855, Dec 13 2024; corrected 90 FR 5724, Jan 17 2025
fcc_47cfr_95_3205.definition: conducted emissions measured at the antenna input, relative to the C-V2X band edges
